source.title: San Diego Supercomputer Center Emergency Action Plan

image.note: Native image extracted with pdfimages -f 24 -l 24 -png. The document cover says Updated 9/2025; PDF creation date in 2026 is not treated as its plan revision.

supportingSource.title: UC San Diego Fall 2025 ECON 232 section 917539: SDSC E129
supportingSource.use: Recent schedule identity only: the lecture and final use E129. No floor, wall geometry or scale is derived from this schedule.

transform.note: One arbitrary relative unit equals ten native source pixels. This is not a conversion to meters, a physical area estimate, or campus registration.

room.label: E129
boundaryNotes: Manual trace follows the centers of the four visible boundary strokes. Native image resolution limits wall-center precision to approximately 1.5 pixels.
The door opening near the lower-right corner is closed along the continuous bottom-wall line to form the footprint; door-swing arcs and emergency icons are not room boundary vertices.
In this source orientation E128 is immediately right, E130 left, E114–E102 above and E154–E147 below the room row. These labels distinguish E129 on PDF page 24 from EB129 on page 23.

floorIdentity.evidence: The East plan sequence starts at physical PDF page 22 and is listed as B2, B1, 1–3. Pages 22–26 follow that order; page 24 carries exact E129 and adjacent E1xx labels. Page 23 uses EB1xx, including the distinct EB129.

historicalConflict.earlierAssignment: East Annex B1 South Wing, E129
historicalConflict.resolution: Superseded for current mapping by the September 2025 numbered plan, corroborated independently by the May 2024 plan. Both distinguish E129/E1 from EB129/EB1. No alias between E129 and EB129 is created.

limitations: Only room E129 is traced. The floor outline is exactly the acquired room extent, not the full East building exterior or a complete floor plan.
All geometry uses relative source-image units. No reliable dimension or area is available for metric calibration.
True north, campus placement, floor height and vertical registration are unknown. No geo record is supplied.
The original Central building shells are archived separately and are not merged with this independent East Annex drawing frame.
The source cover is updated September 2025, but the embedded drawing has no independently readable revision date; later alterations remain possible.
The builder and runtime provenance use the official public PDF only. The private 2024 document is independent research corroboration and is not distributed or needed to rebuild.
